VisionPhotoProblem.description:
Why an analysis got no camera photo from the mower (the most likely cause, judged from
the mower's state at the time and the gateway's answer).
VisionPhotoProblem.title: VisionPhotoProblem

VisionProposalState.description: Lifecycle of an AI assist proposal (one round).
VisionProposalState.title: VisionProposalState

VisionTask.description: What AI assist is asked to do.
VisionTask.title: VisionTask

description:
Payload of ``vision.proposal.updated``: a proposal changed its state.

Published after every state change except the one to ``proposed`` (that is
``vision.proposal.created``). A summary only: the images and the model's full answer stay
behind ``GET /api/v1/vision/proposals/{id}``.

action.description: The default option (`drive`, `return_to_dock`, or `resume`: optional drive steps, then the paused job continues); once approved, the option that runs; null before the analysis decided one.
action.title: Action

alternative_action.description: The model's low-confidence recommendation next to the fallback `action` (after an approval of it, `action` names it and this is null).
alternative_action.title: Alternative Action

final.description: True for a state after which nothing changes any more.
final.title: Final

low_confidence.description: The model's recommendation is offered below the confidence threshold.
low_confidence.title: Low Confidence

photo_problem.description: The analysis got no camera photo, and why. With state `failed` and trigger `error`: the automatic analysis could not run (after its retries); start it by hand once the connection is better.

signal_dbm.description: With `photo_problem` `weak_wifi` or `weak_mobile`: the signal in dBm.
signal_dbm.title: Signal Dbm

steps.description: Number of proposed drive steps (also for `resume`).
steps.title: Steps

title: VisionProposalUpdated
